Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log handover: sample deliverable & timeline request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the call this morning — FinTrust is consolidating the security questionnaire answers and we have one follow-up item from Legal/InfoSec: a concrete example of how Redwood would deliver audit logs and evidence in a contractual handover. Specifically they want: 

- A short, concrete timeline for bulk export of audit records (typical SLA windows for ad-hoc requests).
- A sample manifest and file layout (what metadata is included with each record).
- Confirmation of transfer mechanisms (S3 presigned vs direct SFTP) and integrity guarantees (checksums, delivery verification).

I've attached FinTrust_Export_Spec.xlsx to capture the fields we need. Can you provide a sample playbook or a short deliverable we can circulate to Legal by EOD Monday?

If it's helpful, Procurement would prefer a 3–5 business day window for a standard evidence request and a longer lane for escalations.

Appreciate it — Alicia

--
Alicia Gomez
Head of InfoSec Risk
FinTrust Bank
Alicia.Gomez@fintrust.com
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintrust.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log handover: sample deliverable & timeline request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Pulling together a concise playbook and a minimal sample export makes sense. High level answers below; I attached a draft playbook (redwood-auditplaybook-v1.pdf) and a tiny sample manifest (ft-sample-manifest.csv) for Legal to review.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Standard ad-hoc export SLA: 3 business days for up to 30 days of log history; 7 business days for larger windows (configurable under Dedicated/Private contracts).
- Escalation lane: 48 hours SLA if part of an active incident / litigation hold (requires legal notice).
- Delivery mechanisms: preferred = S3 presigned POST with server-side encryption; alternate = SFTP with client certs. All exports include SHA256 checksums; we provide file-level manifests and delivery receipts.

What we included in the attached playbook
- Export formats: ndjson per event + compressed tarball for bulk transfer
- Manifest fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, source_service, user_id (hashed if PII), request_id, sequence_index, event_type, checksum_sha256
- Chain-of-custody: signed delivery receipt (time-stamped) + optional notarized hash on request
- Redaction options: field-level redaction rules and attestations (policy + sample redacted file)

Two clarifying questions to make the sample exact for Legal:
1) For the sample we should include what retention window? (FinTrust asked for both 90-day and 7-year scenarios; which would you like in the sample?)
2) Preferred transfer method? If S3 presigned, will you provide a bucket prefix and IAM role or do you want us to stage and handoff?

I'll hold the formal playbook until I get your preference and will aim to send the finished PDF + a packaged sample (tar.gz with manifest + checksums) by Monday EOD if we stick to the 3-business-day lane.

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Attached: redwood-auditplaybook-v1.pdf; ft-sample-manifest.csv
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 12:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Audit log handover: sample deliverable & timeline request

Olga — quick internal sync before we send the final to FinTrust. Notes / commitments: 

- SLA commitments: 3 business days for standard exports up to 30 days (we can sign 7 days for up to 90 days in the SOW). Escalations 48 hours with legal notice — confirm that with sales/AE.
- Transfer mechanics: default to S3 presigned PUT for security and resumability. We should offer an optional SFTP lane (longer lead time).
- Integrity: include manifest + per-file SHA256 + overall tarball SHA256. Offer verification script snippet to compute and compare checksums.
- Sample: ship two manifests — one showing 90-day retention subset and one for 7-year rolling archive (synthetic PII hashed).

Action items for the deliverable we will send to Alicia: 
1) Finalize playbook PDF with explicit timeline table.
2) Create sample tar.gz (ft-sample-90d.tar.gz, ft-sample-7y.tar.gz) and upload to our staging bucket; provide presigned URLs in the reply.
3) Add short section on cost/egress estimates for larger exports (ballpark $/GB).

I can prepare the samples this afternoon; Olga, can you confirm you want me to stage them to our staging bucket (redwood-evidence-staging) or wait for FinTrust to give a bucket/prefix?

Ben
Sr. Product Ops
Redwood Inference

If you can get the sample staged and the playbook PDF to us by EOD Monday (June 14) that would keep procurement on schedule. Also loop in Sales if there will be any negotiated SLA language.

I'll expect presigned URLs for the sample and the playbook link once available.
